constraints: Faction action must use actual knowledge, authority, resources, relationships, opposition and geography.
No faction gains free personnel, money, command, territory or information.
Daily operational action selection belongs to the autonomous heartbeat; this process owns slow faction-plan maintenance and development.
goals: maintain and develop active faction plans across elapsed time
wake exact faction owners on material political, military, economic or informational changes
reconstruction_policy: Use each faction owner's current plan, leaders, resources, constraints, relationships and knowledge-access rules plus exact causal state.
replanning_policy: At each boundary or causal wake, reassess supported faction-plan state; material operations are instantiated in their domain authorities before resolution.
safe_compaction_policy: Stable background spans may compact only when no material faction threshold or interaction is skipped.
standing_orders: preserve faction-specific goals and constraints rather than generic activity
defer active next-action selection to the daily autonomous heartbeat or an exact event process
